en.name: Qwen Audio 3.0 TTS Plus Text to Speech
en.description: Synthesize expressive dialogue and narration with Qwen 3.0 flagship voices and natural-language style instructions.

text.help: Enter the text to synthesize. Enable SSML for SSML or LaTeX input.

voice.help: Select a base voice for this model.

instruction.help: Describe the tone, emotion, character, or speaking style in natural language.

custom_voice.help: Enter a voice ID that this model supports to use that voice.

output_format.help: Choose MP3, PCM, WAV, or Opus.

speed.help: 1 is normal speed. Set a multiplier from 0.5 to 2.

pitch.help: 1 keeps the original pitch. Set a multiplier from 0.5 to 2.

bit_rate.help: Used for Opus only. Enter a bitrate in kbps.

language_hint.help: Choose one language or leave blank for automatic detection.

enable_ssml.help: Parse the text as SSML markup or LaTeX.

seed.help: Use -1 for a random seed or enter an integer from 0 to 65535.
